videos.description: A US submarine is dispatched to the frozen wastes of the North Pole to recover a Soviet satellite crammed full of strategic snapshots of US bases. The Cold War atmosphere becomes even chillier as the sub, with a Russian expatriate, a British secret agent and an American marine captain on board, is sabotaged en route.

videos.title: The Rose Tattoo
videos.description: Based on a play by Tennessee Williams, this classic drama centers on Serafina, a widowed Sicilian woman living in the American South who is left devastated by the death of her husband. Grief turns her into a recluse; however, she is drawn back into the world when she learns of her late husband's infidelities. Meanwhile, the arrival of a new lodger, handsome truck driver Alvaro, offers hope of a new love in her life.

videos.title: La vie en rose
videos.description: Born into poverty and raised in a brothel, Édith Piaf (Marion Cotillard) manages to achieve worldwide fame. Though her extraordinary voice and charisma open many doors that lead to friendships and romances, she experiences great personal loss, drug addiction and an early death.

videos.title: Love Is on the Air

videos.title: Hi, Nellie
videos.description: When missing government lawyer Frank Canfield is accused of embezzling state funds, journalist Brad Bradshaw refuses to publish the headline because he considers it sensational and unverifiable. But when the media circus declares Canfield guilty, Brad is demoted for getting scooped by every paper in town. Now forced to write a ladies' advice column, Brad struggles to save face, attract a readership and find out the truth about the Canfield case in hopes of regaining his old job.

videos.title: The House Across the Street

videos.title: The Miracle Worker
videos.description: Blind and deaf after suffering a terrible fever as a baby, young Helen Keller (Patty Duke) has spent years unable to communicate, leaving her frustrated and occasionally violent. As a last chance before she is institutionalized, her parents (Inga Swenson, Andrew Prine) contact a school for the blind, which sends half-blind Annie Sullivan (Anne Bancroft) to teach Helen. Helen is initially resistant, but Annie gradually forms a bond with her and shows Helen ways of reaching others.

videos.title: The Yearling
videos.description: Based on the novel by Marjorie Kinnan Rawlings, this drama focuses on the family of Civil War veteran Penny Baxter (Gregory Peck), who lives and works on a farm in Florida with his wife, Ora (Jane Wyman), and their son, Jody (Claude Jarman Jr.). The only surviving child of the family, Jody longs for companionship and unexpectedly finds it in the form of an orphaned fawn. While Penny is supportive of his son's four-legged friend, Ora is not, leading to heartbreaking conflict.

videos.title: The Hucksters
videos.description: Eager to reestablish his advertising career after the war, Vic Norman (Clark Gable) convinces an executive (Adolphe Menjou) that he can secure the challenging Evans Beauty Soap account. Despite the grating eccentricity of the company head (Sydney Greenstreet) Vic pitches a campaign that includes war widow Kay Dorrance (Deborah Kerr) and tells her the ad will be aboveboard. Falling for the proper Kay, however, Vic grows uncomfortable with the increasingly slick shenanigans necessary to succeed.

videos.title: The Long, Long Trailer
videos.description: Nicholas Collini has to travel for his job as an engineer -- so his fiancée, Tacy, suggests that rather than buy a house after their wedding, they invest in a motor home so they can see the country together. But the aggravations of life with nosy trailer park neighbors and the dangers of piloting an enormous trailer across narrow country roads soon take their toll on the happy couple, putting their young marriage in turmoil.

videos.title: One-Eyed Jacks
videos.description: After pulling a bank heist in Mexico, the outlaw Rio (Marlon Brando) and his partner, Dad Longworth (Karl Malden), make a run for it, but Dad has bigger plans than freedom. He betrays Rio and absconds with the loot, and Rio ends up in prison. Years pass before Rio finally breaks free to enact his long-plotted revenge. Tracking Dad to California, Rio learns he's become a sheriff -- which is no deterrent -- but when Rio falls for Dad's stepdaughter, Louisa (Pina Pellicer), he has second thoughts.

videos.title: Cariboo Trail
videos.description: Though most men are concerned with prospecting gold, American ranchers Jim Redfern and Mike Evans are trying to make a fortune by leading a long line of cattle from Montana to Canada. While they are resting one night, their herd is robbed by a gang of thugs, leaving the cowboys stranded in the wilderness without their livelihood. Jim and Mike then decide to try their hands at mining gold, but before long they run into the enemy bandits again.

videos.title: The Painted Hills
videos.description: A determined prospector, Jonathan Harvey (Paul Kelly) finds gold after years of searching. When he returns to town to tell his partner, Jonathan finds that his friend has died, leaving his son, Tommy (Gary Gray), on his own. While Jonathan's loyal collie, Lassie, stays with the boy, he goes to find help to assist him with his lucrative discovery. However, the new recruit (Bruce Cowling) proves to be a shady character, and before long the ruthless schemer has incurred the wrath of Lassie.

videos.title: Kansas Pacific
videos.description: With the American Civil War looming, construction of the Pacific railroad is being held up in Kansas, sabotaged by Confederate sympathizers. The government dispatches an Army engineer, John Nelson (Sterling Hayden), to oversee construction, and he initially rubs the wrong way both his proud boss (Barton MacLane) and his boss's feisty daughter (Eve Miller). Eventually, though, both fall for Nelson's charms, and the hero seeks to uncover the Southern rat so he can lead the Union men due west.

videos.title: County Line
videos.description: When his best friend is brutally gunned down, a former sheriff is left with many questions and no answers. After the investigation stalls and his replacement turns a blind eye, he takes the case into his own hands.

videos.title: A Fistful of Lead
videos.description: Four of the West's most infamous outlaws carry out a daring bank heist in a gold rush town. As the posse takes chase, things take a turn for the worse, and the bandits realize there's a traitor among them.

videos.title: Chino

videos.title: Boon
videos.description: Mercenary Nick Boon is trying to atone for his life as an enforcer for a ruthless syndicate. Running from his past, Boon moves to a remote area in the Pacific Northwest, where he meets a struggling widow and her son. When he finds the pair living in fear of a criminal kingpin, Boon realizes the only way to protect them is to do what he does best.

videos.description: Troy Von Scheibner first became interested in magic at the age of 12, practiced the art through various odd jobs throughout childhood and college, and now is one of the most popular magicians in England. This reality series shows what happens when the performer hits the streets of London to showcase his close-up magic and stunts for unsuspecting locals and tourists. videos.title: The Public Enemy
videos.description: Two young Chicago hoodlums, Tom Powers (James Cagney) and Matt Doyle (Eddie Woods), rise up from their poverty-stricken slum life to become petty thieves, bootleggers and cold-blooded killers. But with street notoriety and newfound wealth, the duo feels the heat from the cops and rival gangsters both. Despite his ruthless criminal reputation, Tom tries to remain connected to his family, however, gang warfare and the need for revenge eventually pull him away.

videos.title: The Maltese Falcon
videos.description: In this noir classic, detective Sam Spade (Humphrey Bogart) gets more than he bargained for when he takes a case brought to him by a beautiful but secretive woman (Mary Astor). As soon as Miss Wonderly shows up, trouble follows as Sam's partner is murdered and Sam is accosted by a man (Peter Lorre) demanding he locate a valuable statuette. Sam, entangled in a dangerous web of crime and intrigue, soon realizes he must find the one thing they all seem to want: the bejeweled Maltese falcon.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Cuando Rita intenta algunos experimentos en el laboratorio de Mina, ella pronto descubre que primero necesita aprender algunas lecciones básicas para evitar el desastre.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Bello descubre que su mejor amigo Goomo tiene talento para la música. Bello hace todo lo posible para mostrar al grupo el talento de su amigo.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Rita hace sus propios experimentos en el laboratorio de Mina; Goomo pierde sus lentes, pero cuando Dodo es encontrado usando las gafas y puede ver, Goomo debe decidir si tomar sus gafas otra vez.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Rita desea que todo en Jammbo sea de su color favorito, rosa. Sin embargo, cuando todos comienzan a ponerse rosas es una carrera para cambiar a Jammbo a su estado previo antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Rita y Goomo descubren un huevo de Dodo e intentan mirar de cerca, pero cuando lo pierden deben recuperarlo rápidamente.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Cuando los Discos de Sonido se vuelven locos, Bello y Rita deben regresar cada sonido a su lugar apropiado.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Bello está molesto porque necesita llevar un parche, pero sus amigos le demostrarán que una canción puede convertirlo en una diversión.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Goomo cree que sus zapatos mágicos lo llevarán al tesoro cuando haya tomado 100.000 pasos con ellos, pero todos creen que Goomo se ha vuelto loco.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Mina crea unos inventos para ayudar a Bello,Goomo,Rita y Ongo rescatar a la princesa secuestrada.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: El rey es impaciente y quiere probar su nueva adquisición, una bañera que vuela a la música. Cuando el rey la deja sin vigilar por un minuto, Bello y Mina son los primeros que la prueban.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: El Rey nombra a Bello como guardia de su bóveda de juguetes, pero el poder se le sube a la cabeza.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: El Rey se ha hecho daño en la espalda. Los niños tratan de llevarlo sano y salvo de vuelta a la comodidad de su cama en el castillo.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Cuando Mina crea baquetas que hacen música sobre cualquier superficie, los chicos bailan. Mina y Bello entran en una competencia de baile y piden a Goomo que juzgue quién es el mejor, pero Goomo se preocupa de que sus amigos se enojen con él.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Es un día estupendo para dibujar y todos los niños se ponen a ello con ilusión. Bello, que sabe que sus dibujos son los más apreciados por la Reina, no puede esperar para mostrarle a esta su último dibujo.
